references.text: Here God gives Moses instructions on how the tabernacle is to be built, including the boards, bases, and bars that Moses now erects in 40:18.
Describes the actual making of the boards, bases, and bars for the tabernacle that Moses now assembles.
The Lord commands Moses to set up the tabernacle, which he now carries out in verse 18.
Refers back to the day Moses completed the raising of the tabernacle and anointed it.
Describes how the cloud covered the tabernacle on the day it was erected, which happened after Moses' action in Exodus 40:18.
Stephen refers to the tent of testimony that our fathers had in the wilderness, built according to the pattern that Moses saw.
The book of Hebrews mentions that Moses was warned when he was about to set up the tabernacle, to make everything according to the pattern shown to him on the mountain.
Describes the furnishings of the first tabernacle that Moses erected, with its various parts and items.
Completes the account of the setting up: from raising the structure to finishing it with the court and gate.
Connects the making of the boards to their final erection in the tabernacle.
Explains the technical joining of the boards that were raised in chapter 40.
Emphasizes the theology of unity: how different parts are fastened together into one whole.
Lists the same components that were erected in chapter 40, showing the preparation phase.
Connects the making of the acacia wood boards to their final erection.
